# Instructions: Block Patterns

**Header**
```
/**
 * Title: <Readable>
 * Slug: lsx/<slug>
 * Categories: featured, columns
 * Description: <short>
 * Inserter: true
 * Viewport Width: 1440
 */
```
**A11y**
- Meaningful headings; alt text; accessible labels; adequate contrast.

**Acceptance**
- Autoloaded; inserts without errors.
